{{Quote|Consistent reports place the insectoids' home on the planet Huk in the sector of the same name, which the Yam'rii largely conquered in search of strong enemies, resources to plunder and peoples to enslave – at least until they attacked the planet Kalee, from which the warlike Kaleesh species originated. As a reminder, General Grievous was a member of the Kaleesh and had already made a name for himself in the conflicts between his species and the Yam'rii before his (partial) career in the Confederacy. In any case, after many bloody battles, they were able to put the Yam'rii in serious trouble and even invade the planet Huk.|"Species From A to Z"|<ref name="Species From A to Z">{{GermanFanCite|115|Database}}</ref>}}
A ruthless '''war''' was fought between the [[Kaleesh]], a [[species]] of [[Reptile|reptilian]] from [[Kalee]], and the [[Yam'rii]], an [[insect]]oid species from the [[planet]]ary neighbor [[Huk]] in the [[Huk system|same-named]] [[star system]] to [[Kalee system|their own]] in [[Wild Space]] of [[the galaxy]] [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Clone Wars]]. The Yam'rii attacked many planets in their sector and conquered them, taking their resources and [[Slavery|enslaving]] many of their inhabitants, and Kalee suffered greatly. In response, Kaleesh [[warlord]] [[Grievous]] led his people in his [[homeworld]]'s war against the Yam'rii and launched a series of campaigns that spread across the barren Huk worlds. The Yam'rii went to the [[Galactic Republic]] for assistance, and the [[Jedi]] arrived, standing with the Yam'rii against the invaders.

==Prelude==
[[File:Kalee-AEYNTK.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A ruthless war was fought on the planet Kalee between its native Kaleesh and its planetary neighbor, the Yam'rii from Huk.]]
[[Kalee]], in [[Wild Space]], was one of the [[Planet|worlds]] that suffered inadvertent injustice at the hands of the [[Galactic Republic]], as some crimes were missed by the overstretched Republic. The low-tech [[Reptile|reptilian]] [[Kaleesh]] were conquered by the devouring [[Yam'rii]], a greedy insectoid species from the planet [[Huk]]<ref name="The Separatists" /> in the same [[Star system|system]],<ref name="HC 8" /> who mercilessly invaded numerous worlds in the region, stripping them of their resources, selling their populations into [[slavery]],<ref name="The Separatists" /> and searching for strong opponents.<ref name="Species From A to Z" /> When the Yam'rii turned their focus on the Kaleesh's [[homeworld]] Kalee, the results were horrific.<ref name="The Separatists" />

==Battle==
The merciless reptilian Kaleesh and their technologically advanced adversary insectoid Yam'rii engaged in a devastating and ongoing war.<ref name="The Separatists" /> In [[time]], [[Grievous|Qymaen jai Sheelal]]<ref name="Build R2-D2 57" /> learned brutal and determined strategy,<ref name="Dark Side">''[[Star Wars: The Dark Side]]''</ref> battle tactics, and warfare during the war against the Yam'rii<ref name="Rise" /> and the ability to excite, motivate, and lead his fellow Kaleesh warriors in an explanatory way.<ref name="The Separatists" /> Sheelal would adopt the name "Grievous"<ref name="BDOWD">{{EncyclopediaCite|Battle Droids and Other Droids of War}}</ref> and gather<ref name="English Separatists" /> the best Kaleesh warriors,<ref name="The Separatists" /> the [[Izvoshra]],<ref name="BDOWD" /> a group of courageous warriors, to act as his elite personal guard<ref name="Ships and Vehicles 55">{{ShipsandVehiclesCite|55|History of the Ship}}</ref> and fight alongside them for [[Standard year|years]].<ref name="The Separatists" /> Grievous could always rely on<ref name="Ships and Vehicles 55" /> his Izvoshra,<ref name="BDOWD" /> who shared his victories and love of battle,<ref name="Build R2-D2 57">{{BuildR2Cite|57|Droid Directory}}</ref> in his various destructive campaigns on the planet Huk.<ref name="Ships and Vehicles 55" />

He then waged war against the Yam'rii<ref name="English Separatists">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Separatists}} {{C|English version}}</ref> with ferocity and determination, and the Kaleesh forces<ref name="The Separatists" /> invaded Huk<ref name="Species From A to Z" /> and drove the Yam'rii off from their world, but the Yam'rii requested assistance from the Galactic Republic. The Republic<ref name="The Separatists" /> and the [[Jedi]]<ref name="HC 8" /> sided with the Yam'rii<ref name="Rise" /> against the invader. The Kaleesh were condemned, embargoes and fines were enforced,<ref name="English Separatists" /> and hundreds of thousands were starved to [[death]]. After the Republic and the Jedi intervened the conflict,<ref name="The Separatists" /> Grievous developed a personal vendetta against them for their assistance to the Yam'rii.<ref name="Rise" />

==Aftermath==
Eventually, Grievous became an [[Enforcer (occupation)|enforcer]] for the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]], but his request to keep his loyal Izvoshra bodyguards was rejected,<ref name="BDOWD" /> and he was forced to command the IGBC droids. Grievous' demand for an intelligent personal guard led to the creation of the [[IG-100 MagnaGuard]]. After Grievous became one of IGBC's most valuable assets, [[Count]] [[Dooku]] and his [[Sith Master]], [[Darth]] [[Darth Sidious|Sidious]], became aware of his exploits and had important plans for him.<ref name="The Separatists" /> To have Grievous serve under them,<ref name="HC 8" /> Dooku, [[Poggle the Lesser]], and [[San Hill]] planned to destroy him in order to turn him into a [[cyborg]].<ref name="Base Series 1">{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=San Hill - Banking Clan Chairman}}</ref> Under Dooku's direction, [[Grievous' shuttle]] was [[Sabotage of Grievous' shuttle|sabotaged]].<ref name="HC 8" />

The Kaleesh-Yam'rii war was mentioned in "[[Species From A to Z]]," a survival compendium sent out by [[Carson Teva]] during the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="Species From A to Z" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kaleesh-Yam'rii war was first mentioned in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Helmet Collection 8|eighth issue]] of the [[2016]] magazine ''[[Star Wars Helmet Collection]]''.<ref name="HC 8" />

In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], the war first appeared in "[[The Eyes of Revolution]]," a comic story written and illustrated by [[Warren Fu]], published in the [[Dark Horse Comics]] anthology ''[[Star Wars: Visionaries]]'', released on [[April 2]], [[2005]],<ref name="Eyes">{{StoryCite|story=The Eyes of Revolution|book=Star Wars: Visionaries}}</ref> and was first identified as the "Huk War" in ''[[Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous]]'', an article published in the [[Star Wars Insider 86|eighty-sixth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and illustrated by [[Joe Corroney]], released on [[February 21]], [[2006]].<ref name="Unknown Soldier">{{InsiderCite|86|Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous}}</ref>
